Item alia oratio post missam.

Gratias tibi ago et laudes tibi refero domine deus meus qui me ex nihilo ad imagine et similitudine tua creare et tuo precioso sanguine redimere atque per sacri baptismatis ablutionem inter adoptionis filios aggregare precioque corporis et sanguinis tui mysteriis reficere dignatus es. Tibi ergo ago laudes et gratias qui me a tempore rudis infantie mee usque ad hanc horam per multa defluente vitia immense pietatis tue patientia ad emendationem expectasti. Te laudo te glorifico qui me sepissime multis tribulationibus et angustiis calamitatibus et miseriis liberasti. Qui me hactenus ab eternis suppliciis et a corporis et aie cruciatibus misericorditer exemisti. Te laudo te glorifico qui in sospitate membrorum tranquillitate temporum etiam bonorum effectu cum multis aliis virtutibus misericorditer tribuisti. Queso domine deus me ineffabile tua suavitate ut inchoata beneficia dona in me efficias. Et quicquid in me displicet repellas a cunctis etiam que super sunt tribulationibus et iniquitatibus ac diversis malis quibus involutus sum me eripias. prosperities, guard me always and everywhere, and finally bring me happily to the desired joys of Your vision.

<note>A red paragraph mark</note>After Mass:

<note>A red decorative initial 'L'</note>These are the first things that please You, which You left for us orphans in memory of Your love. O Wisdom born of the Virgin, who did not disdain to have Your venerable body touched and received by me, an unworthy sinner. What shall I worthily return to You for all that You have repaid? For if the merits of the whole world were gathered into one, they would not be worthy to be compared to Your dignity in any way. Therefore, I render thanks to You, Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, King of kings and Lord of lords; I offer thanks to the best of my fragile ability to Your trembling majesty and immense piety, most pious Jesus, for You have sweetly refreshed my soul, which was too dry, with Your sacred body and blood. I ask You that whatever is vicious in me and contrary to Your will, You may evacuate it utterly through the power of this sacrament, and prepare my heart as a worthy dwelling place for the Holy Spirit. And, sweetest Jesus, may this sacrament of Your body and blood be the sweetness and pleasantness of my soul, its salvation and sanctity in every temptation, peace and joy in every tribulation, light in every work, and a final protection in death. Amen.

sample.seedTranslation:
fountain of the heart and grace, the true delight of the heart. 
Although I am not able to speak worthily of You, yet I will not be silent; love makes me bold so that I may rejoice concerning You alone. 
Your love, Jesus, is a grateful refreshment of the mind; it fills without satiety, giving desire to the hungry. 
Those who taste You hunger; those who drink still thirst; they cannot desire anything except Jesus, whom they love. 
He whom Your love inebriates knows what Jesus tastes like; the happy taste that satisfies, there is nothing further that he can desire. 
Jesus, angelic beauty, a sweet song in the ear, honey in the mouth, nectar in the heart, heavenly. 
I desire You a thousand times, my Jesus; when will You come to me? When will You make me joyful? When will You satisfy me with Yourself? 
Your continuous love is a persistent longing for me; Jesus, honey-sweet, the perpetual fruit of life. 
Jesus, supreme kindness, wonderful joy of the heart, incomprehensible goodness, Your charity binds me. 
It is good for me to love Jesus, to seek nothing beyond Him, to fail entirely, so that I may be able to live for Him. 
O my sweetest Jesus, hope of the sighing soul, pious tears and the cry of my heart seek You inwardly. 
In whatever place I may be, I desire Jesus with me; how happy when I find Him, how happy when I hold Him! 
Then embraces, then kisses, which exceed cups of honey; in these, without delay, I will follow Jesus through the ages.

co-eternal, glorious, and everlasting Lord, who was crucified for us, deign to consecrate me today with the Holy Spirit, with a most holy heart and chaste body, to receive Him, so that through this sweet nourishment of the most holy body and the drink of His precious blood, all the increments of vices may perish in me, and I may deserve to be united to the very fountain of all goods, in whom, absolved and sanctified, I may be able to see and praise felicitously, forever enjoying Him with the angels, the Lord and Spouse of my soul, the triune and one God, forever and ever. And finally, when this corruptibility is removed, may I freely grasp my most noble co-heir, together with the angels and the chorus of holy virgins, through whom I may know from then on the Trinity and the true Unity, perfectly praising Him forever and ever. Amen.

sample.seedTranslation: come, repairer of all salvation and sweetness. Behold, my soul which You love is sick and cannot recover unless You are its faithful physician, whom it seeks and demands with all desire, because it cannot bear the delay of Your coming any longer. Daughters of Jerusalem, announce to the beloved that I desire greatly that He may console my soul with the colloquy of His own mouth, because without Him I neither wish nor am able to live. I beseech You, Lord Jesus Christ, by Your Paschal victory, that just as You, hanging on the cross, did not keep a single drop of blood in Yourself, so today You may not allow any stain of sin to remain in me. And make me receive Your precious body and blood in such a way that through it I may deserve to progress from grace to grace, so that in Your vision I may deserve to ascend from glory to glory. Come, true salvation of the world; come, Son of the Virgin and crown of virgins. Impose Your paternal and holy hands upon my languishing soul. and most gentle God, grant me, I pray, not only to receive the sacrament of your body and blood, but also the virtue of the sacrament, so that these heavenly sacraments may become for me salvation and life. Grant me to be so satisfied and inebriated by you that I know nothing apart from you forever. Grant me to receive your body, which you drew from the Virgin, in such a way that I may deserve to be incorporated into your mystical body and numbered among its members. Grant me to contemplate you yourself, whom I now propose to receive veiled, with face at last revealed. Savior of the world, who with the Father and the Holy Spirit lives and reigns, God. Adoro te deuote latens deitas que sub his figuris vere latitas. Tibi se cor meum totum subijcit. quia te contemplans totum deficit. Visus gustus tactus in te fallit. sed auditu solo tute credit. Credo quicquid dixit dei filius. verbo veritatis nihil verius. In cruce latebat sola deitas. sed hic latet simul et humanitas. ambo tamen credens atque confitens. peto quod petiuit latro penitens. plagas sicut Thomas non intueor. deum tamen meum te esse confiteor. fac me tibi semper magis credere. in te spem habere te diligere. O memoriale mortis domini. panis vivus vitam prestas homini. Presta mee menti de te viuere. et te illi semper dulce sapere. Pie pellicane Iesu domine. me immundum munda tuo sanguine. Cuius vna stilla saluum facere. totum mundum possit omni scelere. Iesu pie quem nunc velatum aspicio. quando fiet illud quod tam sicio. Vt te reuelata cernens facie. visu sim beatus tue glorie. Amen.
